visual_action: A montage of clips featuring JD Vance. It begins with a close-up of his face, which is then briefly altered to show him with long, dark, curly hair. The montage includes clips of Vance giving a speech at a podium with a 'JD VANCE' sign, walking outdoors, meeting with Donald Trump in an office, visiting a bakery, accepting a trophy with a sports team in front of the White House, and standing in front of Mount Rushmore. Some clips have a ghostly overlay of his face.

cast.name: JD Vance
cast.evidence: He is the subject of every clip in the video, and his image is digitally manipulated.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is briefly shown on screen in a clip with JD Vance in what appears to be the White House.

on_screen_text.text:
JD VANCE

spoken_summary: The audio consists of a male voice singing lyrics from the song 'Creep' by Radiohead over an acoustic guitar. The lyrics include: "I wish I was special, but I'm a creep. I'm a weirdo. What the hell am I doing here? ... I don't belong here."
audio_music: A slow, melancholic acoustic guitar cover of a song, sung by a male vocalist. The somber tone of the music is used ironically to mock the subject of the video, JD Vance, by pairing his image with lyrics describing someone as a 'creep' and a 'weirdo'.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage of various clips of JD Vance, with standard cuts and some slow cross-dissolves and overlays.
manipulation_or_satire: At the beginning of the video, a long, curly dark brown wig is digitally superimposed onto JD Vance's head to make him look odd, reinforcing the song's lyrics calling him a 'weirdo'.
central_claim: JD Vance is an awkward and out-of-place person (a 'creep' and a 'weirdo') who does not belong in the political settings he is shown in.
intended_effect: To ridicule JD Vance and make the viewer see him as an unserious and strange political figure.
